name: CleanSpace Holdings Limited
summary: CleanSpace Holdings Limited engages in the design and manufacture of respiratory protection equipment for healthcare and industrial employers worldwide. It offers CleanSpace HALO, a personal respiratory protection for healthcare; CleanSpace ULTRA, a respirator for eye protection and water tolerance; CleanSpace2, a respirator for various working environments; and CleanSpace EX, an air purifying respirator. The company also provides accessories comprising respirators, masks, filters, cleaning and storage products, biohood system parts, and spares. It serves mining, infrastructure, energy, transport, metal, chemical, healthcare, and defense and government organizations. CleanSpace Holdings Limited was founded in 2009 and is based in Artarmon, Australia.
